questions.question: Rust nima uchun mashhur?
options: Xotira xavfsizligi va tezlik — garbage collector holda

questions.question: Rust da o'zgaruvchi qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Rust da o'zgaruvchi o'zgartirilishi uchun nima kerak?
Rust da ownership nima?
options: Har bir qiymatning bitta egasi bor — scope tugaganda xotira bo'shatiladi

questions.question: Rust da borrowing nima?
options: Qiymatni egalik qilmasdan reference orqali ishlatish — & bilan

questions.question: Rust da println! makro nima qiladi?
options: Konsolga formatlangan matn chiqaradi va yangi qator qo'shadi

questions.question: Rust da String va &str farqi nima?
options: String — owned, heap da; &str — reference, ko'pincha literal — slice

questions.question: Rust da Vec<T> nima?
options: Dinamik o'lchamli, heap da turadigan tipli ro'yxat

questions.question: Rust da match nima uchun?
options: Pattern matching — exhaustive switch kabi, barcha case lar qoplanishi kerak

questions.question: Rust da Option<T> nima?
options: Qiymat bo'lishi (Some(T)) yoki bo'lmasligi (None) mumkin — null ga xavfsiz alternativa

questions.question: Rust da Result<T, E> nima?
options: Ok(T) yoki Err(E) — xato boshqarish uchun xavfsiz qaytarish tipi

questions.question: Rust da struct qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Rust da enum nima?
options: Bir nechta variant bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan tip — ma'lumot ham saqlashi mumkin

questions.question: Rust da cargo nima?
options: Rust paket menejeri va build tool — yangi loyiha, test, build, run

questions.question: Rust da lifetime nima?
options: Reference validligini ta'minlovchi kompilyator tekshiruvi — 'a, 'b kabi belgilar

questions.question: Rust da trait nima?
options: Interfeys kabi — metodlar to'plamini belgilaydi, tiplar implement qiladi

questions.question: Rust da impl nima uchun?
options: Tip uchun metodlar va trait larni implementatsiya qilish bloki

questions.question: Rust da generics nima?
options: Tip parametrlari bilan qayta ishlatiladigan funksiya/tip — fn foo<T>(x: T)

questions.question: Rust da ? operatori nima qiladi?
options: Result yoki Option ning Err/None bo'lsa darhol qaytarish — error propagation

questions.question: Rust da Box<T> nima uchun?
options: Heap da saqlash uchun smart pointer — recursive type, trait ob'ektlar uchun

questions.question: Rust da Rc<T> nima?
options: Single-thread reference counting — ko'p egalik uchun, shared ownership

questions.question: Rust da Arc<T> nima?
options: Ko'p thread li reference counting — Rc ning thread-safe versiyasi

questions.question: Rust da Mutex<T> nima uchun?
options: Ko'p thread da shared mutable ma'lumot — lock() bilan kirish

questions.question: Rust da closure nima?
options: Muhitdan o'zgaruvchilarni yutadigan anonim funksiya — |x| x * 2

questions.question: Rust da Iterator trait nima beradi?
options: next() metodi va map, filter, fold kabi ko'plab metodlar zanjiri

questions.question: Rust da move closure nima?
options: Muhit o'zgaruvchilarini borrow emas, ownership bilan oladi — thread uchun kerak

questions.question: Rust da derive macro nima qiladi?
options: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)] — trait larni avtomatik implement qilish

questions.question: Rust da pattern destructuring nima?
options: let (x, y) = point; match, function args da ham — qiymatlarni ajratish

questions.question: Rust da where clause nima uchun?
options: Generic constraint larni alohida, o'qilishi oson joyda yozish — where T: Display

questions.question: Rust da unsafe nima?
options: Raw pointer, FFI, unsafe trait impl kabi — kompilyator kafolatini chetlab o'tish bloki

questions.question: Rust da type alias nima uchun?
options: type Km = u32 — murakkab tipga qisqa nom berish

questions.question: Rust da if let nima uchun?
options: Bitta pattern uchun match — if let Some(x) = option { ... }

questions.question: Rust da while let nima?
options: Loop ichida pattern matching — while let Some(x) = iter.next()

questions.question: Rust da from/into trait nima uchun?
options: Tiplar o'rtasida konvertatsiya — From<T> implement qilsang Into<T> bepul keladi

questions.question: Rust da borrow checker nima qiladi?
options: Compile time da: bir vaqtda faqat bitta mutable yoki ko'p immutable reference — memory safety

questions.question: Rust da async/await qanday ishlaydi?
options: Future trait asosida — tokio kabi runtime kerak, zero-cost abstraction

questions.question: Rust da Pin<T> nima uchun?
options: Future uchun — ob'ektning xotira manzili o'zgarmasligini kafolatlash (self-referential struct)

questions.question: Rust da zero-cost abstraction nima?
options: Yuqori darajali konstruksiyalar (iterator, closure) kompilyatsiyada oddiy kod kabi — overhead yo'q

questions.question: Rust da proc macro nima?
options: Kompilyatsiya vaqtida token stream qabul qilib, kod yaratadigan maxsus makro turlari

questions.question: Rust da RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) nima?
options: Resurs yutilishi va bo'shatilishi scope bilan bog'liq — Drop trait avtomatik chaqiriladi

questions.question: Rust da variance nima?
options: Generic parametrlar va lifetimeler boshqa tiplarga qanday munosabatda bo'lishi — covariant, invariant, contravariant

questions.question: Rust da Send va Sync trait nima?
options: Send — tip boshqa thread ga yuborilishi mumkin; Sync — reference ko'p thread da bo'lishi mumkin

questions.question: Rust da PhantomData nima uchun?
options: Generic parametrni 'ishlatgan' kabi ko'rsatish — type erasure, variance belgilash

questions.question: Rust da const generics nima?
options: Generic parametr sifatida compile-time konstantalar — [T; N] kabi

questions.question: Rust da monomorphization nima?
options: Generic kod har tip uchun alohida compiled versiyaga aylanadi — zero-cost ammo katta binary

questions.question: Rust da trait object (dyn Trait) nima?
options: Vtable orqali runtime dispatch — dynamic polymorphism, Box<dyn Error> kabi

questions.question: Rust da Cow<'a, B> nima uchun?
options: Clone-on-Write — kerak bo'lganda clone qiladi, read-only bo'lsa reference saqlaydi

questions.question: Rust da no_std nima?
options: Standard kutubxonasiz ishlash — embedded, OS kernel kabi resurs cheklangan muhitlar

questions.question: Rust da MIR (Mid-level Intermediate Representation) nima?
options: Rustning optimizatsiya va borrow checking uchun ichki oʻrta daraja reprezentatsiyasi
